description: Tell the social network that the user has read a private conversation. THE CONTACT SEES IT: blue ticks on WhatsApp, "Seen" on Messenger and Instagram. Reading with list_messages does not do this, and send_message does it on its own, so only call this when the user has actually seen the conversation and wants the contact to know. network_read false means the network has no read receipts, refused (try again later) or, on WhatsApp, the last message is over 30 days old.
name: mark_conversation_read
title: Mark a conversation as read
